_about: Single source of truth for commentary-stream metadata. Every pipeline step reads this; no step writes to it. apply_streams_config.py re-applies these values onto commentary.json after every mutation, so nothing else needs to enforce side/color/label.

philology.bibliographic: Hand-curated philological glosses (Untergang, Übermensch, Adler & Schlange, …) compiled for this edition.

sanchez-pascual-notes.bibliographic: Andrés Sánchez Pascual — translator's footnotes to *Así habló Zaratustra* (Alianza, 1972). Origin: Spanish.

crossref.bibliographic: Cross-references to other works in the Nietzsche corpus.

sanchez-meca.bibliographic: Diego Sánchez Meca, *Nietzsche: la experiencia dionisíaca del mundo* (Tecnos, 2005). Origin: Spanish.

lampert.bibliographic: Laurence Lampert, *Nietzsche's Teaching: An Interpretation of Thus Spoke Zarathustra* (Yale UP, 1986).

rosen.bibliographic: Stanley Rosen, *The Mask of Enlightenment: Nietzsche's Zarathustra* (Cambridge UP, 1995).

klossowski.bibliographic: Pierre Klossowski, *Nietzsche et le cercle vicieux* (Mercure de France, 1969). Origin: French.

deleuze.bibliographic: Gilles Deleuze, *Nietzsche et la philosophie* (PUF, 1962). Origin: French.

sanchez-pascual.bibliographic: Andrés Sánchez Pascual — editorial notes from *Así habló Zaratustra* (Alianza, 1972). Origin: Spanish.

new-cambridge.bibliographic: Keith Ansell-Pearson & Paul Bishop (eds.), *The New Cambridge Companion to Nietzsche's Zarathustra* (CUP, 2022). Origin: English.

sp-introduction.bibliographic: Andrés Sánchez Pascual — introductory essay to *Así habló Zaratustra* (Alianza, 1972). Origin: Spanish.

loeb.bibliographic: Paul S. Loeb, *The Death of Nietzsche's Zarathustra* (Cambridge UP, 2010). Not the Loeb Classical Library.
